subject: Gender Identity Non-Discrimination Policy
overview: The Medford School Committee approved a comprehensive gender identity non-discrimination policy after waiving its second reading, heard updates from the McGlynn schools, and acted on resolutions concerning handbooks and bullying curriculum.

items.title: Good of the Order
items.summary: Members discussed onboarding, ethics, and Massachusetts Association of School Committees training plans for newly elected committee members.

items.title: Consent Agenda
items.summary: Approved bills, payroll, and previous meeting minutes.

items.title: Superintendent's Report
items.summary: Superintendent Edouard-Vincent reported on holiday food drives, student achievements in Model UN and robotics, middle school athletic championships, and staff professional development.

items.title: McGlynn Schools Update
items.summary: Principals Andy O'Brien and Nick Tucci presented fall highlights, student demographics, and instructional and social-emotional initiatives at McGlynn Elementary and McGlynn Middle School.

items.title: Policy ACA-1: Non-Discrimination on the Basis of Gender Identity
items.summary: Approved Policy ACA-1 as amended after the committee voted to waive the second reading, establishing district standards on records, pronouns, student transitions, and facility access.

items.title: Resolution 2023-26: School Handbooks Review
items.summary: Approved an amended resolution requiring handbooks to be submitted for review by May 1, 2024, and establishing an ad hoc subcommittee by March 1 to develop handbook review protocols.

items.title: Resolution 2023-27: Bullying Curriculum Report
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting an administrative presentation on bullying prevention curriculum, amended to include differentiated instruction for English learners and students with disabilities.

items.title: Resolution 2023-28: Superintendent Summative Evaluation Accessibility
items.summary: Failed a resolution that would require translating and posting past and future superintendent evaluation reports on a dedicated website tab.

items.title: Condolences
items.summary: The committee read condolences for deceased community members and former educators and observed a moment of silence.
